purpose: Determine whether V31 tail explosion is caused by conditioning the residual distribution only on scalar backbone bins, and whether full local/multiscale target-free context materially improves held-out conditional quantiles before implementing a new likelihood.

inherited_inputs.rule: reuse and reverify every V35 TNG100/SIMBA/Swift train/validation data, V21 backbone cache, V31 conditional-copula artifact/report, and frozen 16-object selection byte-for-byte

native_voxel_quantile_audit.target: physical residual y_truth minus frozen V14 corrected backbone plus predicted residual DC
native_voxel_quantile_audit.train_lattice: for cube i use stride 4 with axis offsets ((i),(i//4),(i//16)) mod 4, yielding 16^3=4096 native voxels per cube
native_voxel_quantile_audit.train_selection: without-replacement PCG64 permutation of each source lattice in TNG100,SIMBA,Swift order using seed 36031; then concatenate exactly equal source counts
native_voxel_quantile_audit.validation_selection: without-replacement PCG64 permutation of the full native validation voxel population in TNG100,SIMBA,Swift order using seed 36041; target-independent and frozen before validation access
native_voxel_quantile_audit.V31_reference: read the train-only V31 per-backbone-bin residual quantile at each requested probability; retain its constant finite endpoints exactly for diagnosis
scalar_features: radius from observer divided by 10 Mpc/h
native_voxel_quantile_audit.oriented_local_multiscale_features: scalar features plus lexicographically ordered periodic 3x3x3 native patches and 3x3x3 factor-4 parent patches of log1p count, mean velocity, intrinsic sig_v, and backbone; parent patches are repeated to their contained native voxels

fixed_learner.implementation: one sklearn HistGradientBoostingRegressor(loss=quantile) per probability and feature set

metrics: coverage error relative to requested probability

translated_tail_causal_control.objects: exact V35/V31 frozen 16 validation source_index values per domain
translated_tail_causal_control.translation: V31 conditional quantile field rolled by 16 native cells (=5 Mpc/h) in the four V35 directions, then inverted at the unchanged query backbone and exact residual-mean projected
translated_tail_causal_control.reference: the same projected truth cubes repeated once per direction
translated_tail_causal_control.metrics: pooled Q3 delta q99.999 and maximum excess plus Q4 generated/truth mean-delta-squared ratio
translated_tail_causal_control.transport_tail_material: Q3 or Q4 fails the unchanged V31 thresholds in any domain

predeclared_interpretation.local_tail_supported: oriented/scalar pinball loss <=0.90 in all three domains at q=0.001 or q=0.999, or at both q=0.01 and q=0.99
predeclared_interpretation.nonlinear_scalar_tail_supported: scalar/V31 pinball loss <=0.90 in all three domains under the same tail rule
predeclared_interpretation.tail_calibration_required: absolute empirical coverage error <=0.002 at q=0.001/0.999 and <=0.005 at q=0.01/0.99
predeclared_interpretation.next_if_local_supported: fit a train-only local conditional scale body plus non-saturating extreme-value tail continuation, then run a matched V31 donor transport control
predeclared_interpretation.next_if_only_scalar_supported: replace V31 bins by a smooth nonlinear scalar conditional body plus train-only extreme-value continuation
predeclared_interpretation.next_if_neither_supported_but_transport_: the tail failure is joint donor-query coupling rather than marginal tail prediction; replace donor transport with a joint query-aligned conditional stochastic field
predeclared_interpretation.next_if_neither_supported_and_transport_: audit the pooled Q3/Q4 implementation and donor selection provenance before further model changes
